_comment: Section-heading words that mark the start of a reference list, matched case-insensitively (a leading section-marker glyph like '■' and a trailing ':' or '.' are tolerated; internal spaces match any whitespace). Single source of truth for the body/bibliography cut, the column-aware re-extraction and the PDF link-layer's bibliography-region detection. Add a heading (any language) to cover a new publisher/locale without touching code.
_further_reading_comment: A SECOND list some publishers print after the references: works the authors recommend but never cite. Its entries are not references — nobody cites them, by design — so counting them as uncited references would report a coverage hole in a complete bibliography. Matched like the headings above.
